BiblicalUsage: Ramjah was an Israelite, one of the sons of Parosh, who had taken a strange wife in the days of Ezra. He is named among those who put away their foreign wives at Ezra's command.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that Ramjah's name stands in a hard list: the men who obeyed, put away what God forbade, and began again.
